title: Determinants of spliceostatin reactivity at a spliceosomal zinc finger
authors: Rozza R; Parise A; Aupic J; Spinello A; Pena V; Magistrato A
one_liner_zh: 该文通过MD/QM-MM模拟研究剪接体锌指蛋白PHF5A与小分子抑制剂spliceostatin的共价反应机制，虽涉及锌指蛋白-DNA互作背景，但核心是蛋白-小分子共价结合，非TF-DNA互作体系，方法可迁移性有限。
abstract: Branch-site recognition is a pivotal event in spliceosome assembly, and branch-site antagonists disrupt this process, inducing a splicing rewiring that underlies much of their antitumor activity. Antagonists from the spliceostatin family covalently bind the SF3b complex nearby the branch-site pocket, forming an adduct with Cys26 of the PHF5A zinc finger while remarkably preserving Zn2+; coordination - an unconventional mode of covalent inhibition. Yet the molecular features that activate this normally protected ZnCys4 cysteine and initiate spliceostatin's epoxide ring opening have remained obscure. Here, we combine extensive classical and QM/MM molecular dynamics simulations to map the full reactive trajectory of spliceostatin attachment to PHF5A. We identify two alternative noncovalent spliceostatin binding poses and show that only its thermodynamically favoured conformation pre-organizes the epoxide for nucleophilic attack. The local distortion of the ZnCys4; coordination sphere weakens the Zn-Cys26 bond, enabling water-Cys26 exchange and generating a highly reactive nucleophilic thiolate. Covalent bond formation is subsequently accelerated by an Asp34-Lys29 proton relay that activates the epoxide leaving group. Free-energy calculations confirm that the overall reaction is fast and strongly exergonic. Together, these findings provide a complete mechanistic framework for zinc-assisted inhibition of early spliceosomes by branch-site antagonists and advance our fundamental understanding of zinc finger reactivity.
abstract_zh: 分支位点识别是剪接体组装中的关键事件，分支位点拮抗剂会破坏这一过程，诱导剪接重连，这构成了其大部分抗肿瘤活性的基础。来自剪接抑制素家族的拮抗剂共价结合SF3b复合体，靠近分支位点口袋，与PHF5A锌指的Cys26形成加合物，同时显著保留Zn2+；配位——这是一种非常规的共价抑制模式。然而，激活这一通常受保护的ZnCys4半胱氨酸并启动剪接抑制素环氧环开环的分子特征仍不清楚。在此，我们结合广泛的经典和QM/MM分子动力学模拟，绘制了剪接抑制素附着于PHF5A的完整反应轨迹。我们识别出两种替代的非共价剪接抑制素结合姿态，并表明只有其热力学上有利的构象才将环氧预组织用于亲核攻击。ZnCys4配位球体的局部畸变削弱了Zn-Cys26键，使水-Cys26交换成为可能，并生成高反应性的亲核硫醇盐。随后，Asp34-Lys29质子中继加速共价键形成，激活环氧离去基团。自由能计算证实整体反应快速且强烈放能。综合这些发现，为分支位点拮抗剂对早期剪接体的锌辅助抑制提供了完整的机制框架，并推进了我们对锌指反应性的基本理解。
